adjudication.analysisCoverage: 26/26 viewport screenshots analyzed (viewport-authoritative; full-page captures archived only)
fixedDefects: tailwind.config.js — added missing muted.light (#B8A99A) and muted.cream (#C2B5A3) tokens; text-muted-light had no Tailwind definition, so 121 usages fell back to inherited dark text on dark surfaces (empty-state and settings copy).
app/session/review.tsx — moved export status, timing/streak, and fallback-MIDI messages from text-wood-600 (dark-on-dark) to text-muted-brown.
components/TabViewport.tsx and components/TabViewport.web.tsx — inactive tab labels now use text-wood-600 on light cards and text-muted-light on dark cards.
components/play/PlayPitchBeatCard.tsx and components/play/PlayPitchLadderVertical.tsx — embedded dark-surface variants now use text-muted-light; standalone light variants keep text-wood-600.

components/play/PlayCaptureCard.tsx, PlayCaptureControls.tsx, PlayCaptureLessonCardBanner.tsx, components/WaveformPlaybackActions.tsx, components/ScoreViewer.tsx, components/SessionPlanBar.tsx, app/review-archive/[sessionId].tsx — light-surface muted copy switched from text-muted-light to text-wood-600.

app/settings/feedback.tsx, app/(tabs)/settings.tsx, components/ChordStrip.tsx — feedback controls meet 44px touch targets with explicit accessible labels; failed server exports preserve the error toast.

adjudication.captureArtifact: Viewport-first capture plus document.fonts.ready settle eliminated the blank full-page artifact: 0/26 full-page PNGs are blank. The loop now derives gaps from viewport screenshots only; full-page images are archival.
adjudication.rationale: The remaining warning flags are keyword-derived false positives from descriptive vision-model prose (e.g. color/palette/font used descriptively). Viewport inspection confirms the dark wood theme, readable copy, and intentional light surfaces (/review-archive journal, score parchment). No actionable cosmetic defect remains. /session/tune is a real mic-device error in headless Chromium; it is waived for the cosmetic audit and tracked as a functional follow-up.
